/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/rok-lo-abbas-ko.md')
original = p.read_bytes()
header, roman_and_body = original.decode().split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
roman, body = roman_and_body.split('\\n---\\n', 1)
changes = {
'Qaime':'Khaime', 'Qaimon':'Khaimoṅ', 'gh aiz':'gh aiz',
'ghaiz meiṅ abbas e alamdar':'ghaiz meiṅ Abbas alamdaar',
' shabbir ':' Shabbir ', ' zainab':' Zainab', ' abbas':' Abbas',
'tatbir':'tadbir', 'shahe abraar':'shah-e-abraar',
'E saani e zehra':'Ae saani-e-Zehra', 'saani e hyder':'saani-e-Haidar',
'hataye':'hataaye', 'Abbas e dilwar':'Abbas dilaawar',
'Mehshar ke hai':'Mahshar ke haiṅ', 'nana se':'naana se',
'Hum usko':'Hum us ko', 'aaye hai\\n':'aaye haiṅ\\n',
'kuch fikr nahi':'kuchh fikr nahiṅ', 'Hum din':'Hum din'.replace('din','deen'),
'janaze':'janaaze', 'tiroṅ ki bauchar':'tiroṅ ke bauchhaar',
'Sanche':'Saanche', 'dhaalna':'dhaalna', 'alambardaar':'alambardaar',
' aaya hai':' aaya hai', 'moharram':'Muharram', 'Ashur':'Aashur',
'kaise roke':'kaise rokeṅ', 'karo ek baar':'karo ik baar',
'ghazi':'ghaazi', 'Qat khaynch':'Khat khinch', 'Hyder':'Haidar',
'Taqeer':'Taakhir', 'bechaini':'bechaini', 'aamir o fakhri':'Aamir o Faqri',
'Wo pyari':'Woh pyaari', 'laachar':'laachaar',
}
for old, new in changes.items():
    if old "'!= new:
        assert old in roman, old
        roman = roman.replace(old, new)
source_lines = [line for line in body.splitlines() if line.strip()]
roman_lines = roman.splitlines()
assert len(source_lines) == len(roman_lines)
assert (source_lines[0], roman_lines[0].strip()) == ('"'۱', '1')
for source, translit in zip(source_lines[1:], roman_lines[1:]):
    assert translit.startswith('  ')
    assert source.count('ں') == translit.count('ṅ'), (source, translit)
updated = (header + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + roman + '\\n---\\n' + body).encode()
assert updated.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == original.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1]
p.write_bytes(updated)
print(len(roman_lines) - 1, 'paired verses')
